findings.issue: Search debounce timer is never cancelled on component destroy; a navigation away within 200ms of typing triggers router.navigate afterwards, overwriting the user's new route
findings.suggestion: Register clearTimeout via DestroyRef.onDestroy, or use takeUntilDestroyed on an RxJS debounce

findings.issue: All four resolvers catch every error and return null, so a transient API/network failure renders 'Not found' (and a 200-status SSR page) instead of an error state; no withNavigationErrorHandler exists either
findings.suggestion: Catch and inspect HttpErrorResponse status: only 404 (and the like) should map to null; propagate other errors and add a global navigation error handler or error UI

findings.issue: withEventReplay() is redundant in Angular v22 — provideClientHydration() enables incremental hydration (which includes event replay) by default, and the CLI schematic no longer emits it
All routes are eagerly imported, so every page's code is in the initial bundle despite an initial-budget warning of 500kB
findings.suggestion: Use loadComponent per route for standard code splitting

findings.issue: allowedHosts: ['*'] disables host verification; SSR guidance says keep an explicit list unless a trusted proxy validates headers
findings.suggestion: If the harness's host truly varies, at least scope the wildcard to the deployment environment (e.g. via env var) instead of hardcoding '*'

findings.issue: Mixed naming conventions across the app: suffixless 'page' files (home.page.ts → HomePage) coexist with role-suffixed cards.component.ts/pokeapi.service.ts, and class PokeApi doesn't match its file name
findings.suggestion: Pick one convention (the v20+ intent-over-role style or classic suffixes) and apply it uniformly

findings.issue: `value="{{ q() }}"` binds the value attribute; after the user has interacted with the input, attribute updates don't change the visible property, so back/forward navigation can leave stale search text
findings.suggestion: Bind the property ([value]) or reconcile via an effect when q() changes without user input

findings.issue: Rows are tracked by $index, so every sort re-renders the entire table body instead of reusing row DOM nodes
findings.suggestion: Track by a stable key (e.g. apiName + level)

findings.issue: The dynamic-title effect (inject(Title) + effect setTitle) is duplicated verbatim in four page components
findings.suggestion: Extract a shared helper (e.g. a setTitle effect factory or a reusable directive) or compute the title in a route-level title resolver

summary: This is a confident, current-idiom Angular 22 SSR app: signal-based components, resolver-to-input data flow, per-route RenderMode.Server, and real 404 statuses via RESPONSE_INIT, all with genuinely explanatory comments. The few real defects are small and local — an uncleared debounce timer, catch-all resolvers that misreport API failures as not-found, and no navigation-error handling. I'd merge it after one short round of fixes; everything else is polish.
